title: Uniform and Clock
author: J. M. Voss
blurb: Gideon Dunmore, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
